title: Your kingdom should fit around your life, Crown Lands’ shield changes
author: explocion200
selftext:
​

Disclaimer : Crownlands has been developed 100% with AI 🫣

Gaming should be fun, not another obligation.

Crown Lands is a persistent, 24/7 medieval RTS. We love the strategy and rivalries that creates, but we also understand how demanding it can feel. Players need time to sleep, work, spend time with family, and simply switch off.

That’s why we’ve adjusted shield availability to allow up to 18 hours of coverage a day: a 12-hour shield from the regular Shop and a separate 6-hour shield available through an unlocked Level 5 Clan Shop. Normal shield activation and protection rules still apply.

Why stop at 18 instead of 20? We’re still a small community. We want to give players breathing room while keeping enough opportunity for meaningful PvP. With fewer players, extending protection too far could leave the battlefield quiet.

We’re finding that balance with the people playing and we welcome new players who want to help shape it.

Our commitment is a fun strategy game that’s never pay to win, where your feedback helps us improve.

What helps you enjoy a persistent RTS without feeling tied to it?

🏰 Join us: [playcrownlands.com](http://playcrownlands.com/play)
